verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents automated evidence collection that syncs with hundreds of connected tools. It runs continuous daily monitoring with alerts on failing tests, which provides the scheduled, machine-gathered cadence. Custom resources can also be pushed via API so Secureframe handles normalization and testing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that collected artifacts are timestamped and retained as auditor-ready evidence in place of screenshots, detail on per-integration collection frequency, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing pages.
